question: Barindra Kumar Ghosh, Abhinash Bhattacharya and Bhupendranath Dutta were associated with which movement in March 1906
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swadeshi movement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Swadeshi Movement was a prominent campaign initiated in **1905** in response to the partition of Bengal by Lord Curzon.
 
• It aimed to promote **self-reliance** by encouraging Indians to boycott British goods and use indigenous products.
 
• Barindra Kumar Ghosh, Abhinash Bhattacharya, and Bhupendranath Dutta were notable figures associated with revolutionary activities linked to the Swadeshi Movement.
 
• The movement played a crucial role in fostering **nationalist sentiments** among Indians during the early 20th century.
 
• Important methods of protest included **boycott, public meetings, and promotion of local industries** such as handloom and khadi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Partition of Bengal (1905):**

 
 
• Executed by Lord Curzon to divide Bengal on religious grounds into East Bengal and West Bengal.
 
• The partition led to widespread unrest and the rise of the Swadeshi Movement as a form of protest.
 
 
 
• **Swadeshi Ideology:**
 
 
• Focused on economic independence and self-sufficiency.
 
• Promoted local industries, craftsmanship, and indigenous education systems.
 
 
 
• **Revolutionary Activities:**
 
 
• Barindra Kumar Ghosh and others were involved in underground revolutionary groups like **Jugantar**.
 
• These groups aimed to overthrow British rule through armed resistance.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Swadeshi Movement:**
 
 
• Strengthened the nationalist movement and sowed seeds for India's independence struggle.
 
• Encouraged Indians to value and promote indigenous products and culture.
